//: #847/#848: the runtime view plugins (../view-plugins/*/web/src) are type-checked here, against the REAL SDK barrel, so a change to public.ts that breaks a shipped plugin is a red typecheck rather than a broken panel. A separate project on purpose: its `paths` send every bare import to THIS package's node_modules (a plugin file lives outside it), and applied to the app's own sources that mapping would change which declaration files they resolve (it skips package `exports`). A plugin's own dependencies still resolve: when `paths` finds nothing, tsc walks up from the importing file to the plugin's own node_modules.
